items.title: Sainsbury’s extends AI self-checkout prompts to convenience stores
summary: A report published on 26 November said Sainsbury’s is introducing camera-based self-checkout prompts in its convenience stores after renewing its partnership with SAI.
The system flags possible missed scans and lets shoppers correct them; the companies say it already processes more than two million transactions a day in supermarkets.
items.why: The expansion illustrates how retailers are applying computer vision to reduce checkout losses while trying to preserve a smooth customer experience.
